name: Energy Graph Scan Vision-style Axis Reasoning

rules.channel: Exactly one checked channel => confirm it. Multiple checked => confirm only if foreground trace color maps to one of selected channels; otherwise Unknown. Unknown never blocks analysis.
rules.manual_mode: Manual Gain/Noise is authoritative. Axis OCR from the opposite family is forbidden from overriding manual mode.
rules.auto_mode: Auto compares Gain and Noise as separate hypotheses using trace shape + Y-axis numeric-label series + grid-step consistency. Axis OCR may correct Auto only when decisively stronger.
rules.axis: Never assume lowest gridline is zero. Read visible left Y-axis numeric labels. Require label order and value-step to agree with major-grid spacing. Two or more anchors preferred; one-anchor fallback is low-confidence only.
rules.gain: Gain Low/High uses automatic plateau/transition detection with stable-outer-plateau fallback. No fixed x split.
rules.noise: Noise Low/High uses semantic Sample#270 positional split with a transition exclusion margin; amplitude separation is not required.
rules.overlay: Overlay lines are drawn from measured trace pixels, not from values converted back to pixels.
rules.numeric_safety: If axis reasoning is not trustworthy, retain trace/channel/mode/overlay but withhold numeric Low/High and SPEC rather than output misleading values.
